name: Kimi Code

version_poll.transform: version = heading version; sections Features/Polish/Bug Fixes are the release notes

release_notes: Use the curated docs changelog blocks; EXCLUDE entries prefixed 'web:' (web UI, not the CLI). Deep technical detail: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/main/apps/kimi-code/CHANGELOG.md
local_binary: ~/.kimi-code/bin/kimi --help (the binary is `kimi`, not `kimi-code`) — useful ground truth, but check its version against the release being synced
gotchas: Docs are bilingual — only use /en/ pages; llms.txt interleaves /zh/ entries
Binary is `kimi`, package/repo are kimi-code; ignore stale 'kimi-cli' content elsewhere
KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_* env flags churn within ~2 releases — expect DEL entries when a feature becomes always-on
Any docs page is fetchable as raw markdown by appending .md
